label: create-artifact-help
stdout:
usage: harnessctl create-artifact [-h] --domain DOMAIN --type ARTIFACT_TYPE
                                  [--id ARTIFACT_ID] [--dry-run] [--quiet]
                                  [--json]
                                  [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --domain DOMAIN
  --type ARTIFACT_TYPE
  --id ARTIFACT_ID      explicit identifier; omitted, the lowest free TYPE-
                        DOMAIN-NNN across every local ref is allocated
  --dry-run             report the complete plan without writing
  --quiet               do not print the authoring checklist after creation
  --json                emit one se-harness-command-result-v1 object
